asked.item: Can I give Blotato the PDF file itself to post as a LinkedIn document
Would the document show the file name as its title
Posting to a LinkedIn company Page

verdict.reason: The sentences only say carousels are built from 2-10 JPG or PNG image URLs and never state whether a PDF file can be supplied as input, and nothing says how a document title is set, so both questions are unanswered.
